rendered_html: 📔 Regulatory Bulletin — 7 September 2026 (Daily) Executive Summary • 🟡 The SFC signals possible further guidance on applying existing principles to agentic-AI use cases; no final guidance, deadline or prescribed technology design was announced. • Investment-facing AI use cases warrant monitoring for ownership, human oversight, access scope, testing, monitoring, resilience and escalation considerations if SFC follow-up materialises. Hong Kong 🟡 Powering Next Wave of Market Growth through AI and RMB Internationalisation 🇭🇰 Item ID: item-20260904-sfc-web-7b93af15cc ⏰ Deadline: No source deadline stated Products: Investment services; Digital channels The Securities and Futures Commission’s 4 September 2026 news record links to its Chief Executive’s speech synopsis, which says the SFC is considering guidance on applying existing principles to agentic-AI use cases. The synopsis identifies ownership and human oversight, controlled access and defined scope, testing and monitoring, operational resilience, and escalation and remediation as relevant outcomes. This is a prospective supervisory signal, not final guidance, a new rule or a prescribed technology design. Firms with investment-facing AI use cases may monitor subsequent SFC guidance and consider how relevant uses are governed; the scope and timing remain open. Source: Powering Next Wave of Market Growth through AI and RMB Internationalisation Primary source: official speech synopsis SG/UK/GLOBAL Benchmark Comparable overseas developments and commercial/control benchmarks. They do not establish Hong Kong requirements. No qualifying benchmark developments were included in this run. Watch List • Monitor for any SFC guidance that clarifies the application of existing principles to agentic-AI use cases, including the firms, use cases and timing covered.
